changeSet.author: eduar.troyano
changeSet.comment: Crea la tabla consents: autorizaciones de tratamiento de datos y de participación en el piloto; solo una vigente por usuario y tipo. Incluye secuencia propia, tabla de auditoría consents_audit y el trigger consents_audit_trg.

createTable.remarks: Consents granted or revoked by users (Law 1581 data processing and pilot research)

column.name: public_id
column.remarks: Public identifier exposed by the API instead of the sequential id

column.name: document_version
column.remarks: Version of the legal document the user accepted

column.name: revoked_at
column.remarks: Moment the consent was revoked; null while valid

column.name: active
column.remarks: Logical state: false means deactivated (rows are never deleted)

column.name: updated_at
column.remarks: Last update timestamp, maintained by the set_updated_at trigger

changeSet.sql: ALTER TABLE consents ADD CONSTRAINT consents_type_ck CHECK (consent_type IN ('data_processing', 'pilot_research'))
ALTER TABLE consents ADD CONSTRAINT consents_revoked_ck CHECK (revoked_at IS NULL OR revoked_at >= granted_at)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX consents_user_type_open_uq ON consents (user_id, consent_type) WHERE revoked_at IS NULL
CREATE TRIGGER consents_set_updated_at_trg BEFORE UPDATE ON consents FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION set_updated_at()

column.name: audit_id
column.remarks: Primary key of the audit row

column.name: record_id
column.remarks: Id of the audited row in consents

column.name: db_user
column.remarks: Database user that made the change

column.name: app_user_id
column.remarks: Application user that made the change (smartmentor.current_user_id)

changeSet.sql: ALTER TABLE consents_audit ADD CONSTRAINT consents_audit_operation_ck CHECK (operation IN ('INSERT', 'UPDATE', 'DELETE'))
CREATE TRIGGER consents_audit_trg AFTER INSERT OR UPDATE OR DELETE ON consents FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION audit_row_change()

rollback.sql: DROP TRIGGER IF EXISTS consents_audit_trg ON consents
